main.content:
==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌkæpɪtəl ˈsɪti/}}
* {{audio|en|EN-AU ck1 capital city.ogg|a=AU}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q5119}}A city that is a [[seat of government]].
# A city (or cities) much larger or more important to a country than all others, regardless of the actual [[seat of government]] ([[cf.]], [[w:Moscow|Moscow]] and [[w:Saint Petersburg|Saint Petersburg]] regardless of moves of the [[Russian]] government; [[w:Amsterdam|Amsterdam]] despite the [[Dutch]] [[w:Capital of the Netherlands|government having been situated]] in [[w:The Hague|The Hague]] since 1588).
# {{label|en|AU}} The major [[metropolitan area]]s of Australia ([[w:Sydney|Sydney]], [[w:Melbourne|Melbourne]], [[w:Brisbane|Brisbane]], [[w:Perth|Perth]], [[w:Adelaide|Adelaide]]), all of which happen to be [[w:List of Australian capital cities|state capitals]], and by extension the major metropolitan areas of other countries; note that other state capitals [[w:Hobart|Hobart]], [[w:Darwin, Northern Territory|Darwin]], and national capital [[w:Canberra|Canberra]] are often excluded.

====Synonyms====
* {{qualifier|by ellipsis}} [[capital]]
